payload.body: ST0002/WP02: PASS on the three commits (9224d6f, 30feba7, 8713a69), with your run at b18d115, whose src, tests and Cargo files equal the landed 7301020. vc closed WP02 with intent wp done after intent at lint ST0002 came back clean, 9 of 9.
